descriptions.w3d_nuclear_destroy_800d24e0: Releases nuclear utility effects and resources before destroying the utility base.
descriptions.w3d_nuclear_detach_800d2790: Clears the global nuclear utility, releases its effect and pending slot, and detaches the base.
descriptions.w3d_nuclear_step_800d2848: Initializes the nuclear utility deadline and activation message once, then advances its base.
